title: Residents urged to keep pets out of Stoughton pond after dog’s death
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Stoughton officials caution against swimming in Ames Pond after a dog died likely due to algae.
The Board of Health is investigating Ames Pond; E. Coli tests showed no issues, algae bloom suspected.
Cyanobacterial blooms can develop rapidly and pose health risks to humans and animals, officials warn.

title: Former NH state trooper decertified after misleading police about using GPS to track girlfriend
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Former NH trooper James Lamoureux was decertified for misleading police about using GPS to track his girlfriend.
Lamoureux pleaded guilty to false reporting and received a fully suspended six-month prison sentence for two years.
He resigned from law enforcement and is barred from future police employment, per the Attorney General's office.

title: Man polishing powder horn outside Lexington church prompts bizarre police response
author: Darin Zullo
bullets: Lexington police responded to Grace Chapel for a report of a man with a gun, causing a lockdown.
The man was polishing a powder horn, a musket-era accessory, while waiting for his wife outside the church.
Police determined there was no threat, but the incident led to road closures and multiple police cruisers on-site.

title: Longtime sports analyst Rob Parker not sold that Red Sox will make playoffs
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox hold the second A.L. wild-card spot with a 64-52 record, following a 32-6 run since June 25.
Sports analyst Rob Parker predicts the Red Sox will miss the playoffs despite high winning streaks and playoff odds.
FanGraphs gives Boston a 96% playoff chance, with 83.4% odds to clinch a wild-card and 12.6% to win A.L. East.

title: Chad Tracy ‘hopeful’ Wilyer Abreu is back in Red Sox lineup Sunday
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Wilyer Abreu was a late scratch from the Red Sox lineup Saturday due to leg swelling from a hit Friday.
Chad Tracy is hopeful Abreu will return for Sunday's game after receiving treatment for the minor ailment.
Abreu has contributed significantly this season with 20 home runs and 62 RBIs, batting .256 with a .793 OPS.

title: Red Sox’ latest winning streak ends at 9 games after loss to Athletics
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: The Boston Red Sox's nine-game winning streak ended with a 7-3 loss to the Oakland Athletics on Saturday.
Starting pitcher Jake Bennett allowed four earned runs over 5.1 innings, surrendering Boston's initial 2-0 lead.
The loss is Boston's sixth in 38 games, though they maintain the second American League wild-card spot.

title: Here’s why Gillette Stadium is swapping out its turf surface again so soon after the World Cup
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: Gillette Stadium is replacing its turf surface prior to the Patriots' preseason, following NFL procedural requirements.
The current turf was accepted for FIFA and NFL performance but missed laboratory approval due to scheduling.
The new turf version previously used in 2025 will be installed, addressing NFL testing compliance issues.

title: 4 takeaways from the Revolution’s loss vs. Houston Dynamo
author: Hayden Bird
bullets: New England Revolution lost 2-0 to Houston Dynamo at Gillette Stadium.
Jack Harrison made his Revolution debut in the 55th minute, showing potential despite limited recent play.
Houston's Guilherme and Resch scored, exploiting New England's defensive lapses and securing the victory.

title: Here’s the latest injury updates on Roman Anthony, Adley Rutschman
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Roman Anthony has been out since May with a wrist injury and is now hitting off a pitching machine.
Adley Rutschman made a rehab appearance for Worcester Red Sox, catching for five innings and throwing out a runner.
Both Anthony and Rutschman are expected to soon enhance the Red Sox lineup, which is currently on a 9-game winning streak.

title: New on Netflix and more: Top streaming picks for August 2026
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Queue' highlights streaming picks, including 'Clueless', a 1995 film available on Netflix, YouTube, and Peacock.
Bo Burnham's directorial debut, 'Eighth Grade', explores middle school anxiety and streams on Netflix.
'Star Trek: Strange New Worlds' Season 4 receives positive feedback for its engaging storylines.
